revision.title: Explore DGT Craftsmen Training Scheme trades
revision.summary: Compare CTS trades delivered through ITIs; entry qualifications and durations vary by trade.
revision.description: The Directorate General of Training describes the Craftsmen Training Scheme as vocational training delivered through ITIs. If you have completed Class 10, check the minimum qualification, subjects and duration for each named trade; do not assume every trade has the same entry rules.

steps: Check the current minimum qualification for a specific trade
Compare the trade and available ITI options
Confirm the trade duration and admission process with the responsible authority

progression.title: Check trade-specific entry conditions
progression.description: DGT's trade list gives different minimum qualifications for different trades. Confirm the current requirement and any subject conditions for the trade you choose.

progression.title: Check the ITI and admission route
progression.description: CTS is delivered through ITIs. DGT describes national policy, standards, examinations and certification as central responsibilities, while day-to-day ITI administration and admissions sit with States/UTs.

progression.title: Complete the named trade programme
progression.description: DGT describes CTS trade/course durations as one or two years, but the duration depends on the specific trade. Confirm current details with the relevant ITI or State/UT authority.

qualification.title: CTS trade qualification
qualification.description: The scheme includes trade-specific training and certification. Confirm the current certificate and awarding arrangements for the selected trade with DGT and the responsible State/UT authority.

considerations.title: Entry rules vary by trade
considerations.description: DGT's list includes different minimum qualifications, including Class 8 and Class 10 requirements. Check the current rules for the exact trade; this route does not guarantee eligibility.

considerations.title: Duration depends on the trade
considerations.description: DGT describes CTS courses as one or two years. Confirm the duration of the specific trade before making a decision.

considerations.title: Admission administration is local
considerations.description: DGT distinguishes national scheme functions from State/UT day-to-day administration and ITI admissions. Use the current State/UT process for applications.

sources.authority: Directorate General of Training, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
sources.termsNotes: Official DGT scheme page. Do not state the page's trade count as a timeless fact; it may change.
sources.expectedUpdateBehavior: Recheck the current DGT scheme page and State/UT admission process during review.
